title: 5.5.11 Challenges: Make it yours
description: The game is complete. Change one rule of your own: a snake that speeds up as it eats, a best score that survives a loss, or a fix for the quick double-turn. Pick one; add an idea of your own on top if you like.

steps.title: Pick a rule and change it
steps.instructions: Choose one of the three challenges on the page above. The check turns green when any one of them is in your code, so one is enough. An idea of your own is welcome on top of it. Start from the game in the editor.
hints: Whatever you pick, press R afterwards and check the game still starts cleanly.

steps.title: Name what you changed
steps.instructions: At the top of `script.js`, write one sentence as a `//` comment saying what your rule is and what would happen if you removed it.
hints: A rule is something the game decides. 'The snake speeds up with each food' is a rule; 'I changed a colour' is not.

requirements.title: Your rule is in the code
requirements.description: One of the three challenges is there: a beat that gets shorter, a best score kept across rounds, or a turn stored in turnX and turnY for the next step. Help: 5.5.2 (Reading: A world on a grid) and 5.5.4 (Lab: Steer it)
